Haan, bilkul theek. Ghumaya hua square wahi square hai, toh uske kone ab bhi right angle hain. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam karke hal karte hain. Sonu ki ek tile tirchi lagi hai. Usne tester seedha rakha toh fit nahi hua, aur Sonu bola: is tile ka kona right angle nahi hai. Tester tirchi tile ke kone par seedha rakhoge, ya tile ke saath ghuma kar?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam karke hal karte hain.

director.text: ghumaana padega

Bilkul, ghuma kar: tester ke seedhe kinaare tile ki bhujaon ke saath. Ghuma kar rakhne par tester tile ke kone mein bilkul fit hua; beech mein koi khaali jagah nahi bachi. Tumhari baari: toh kya Sonu theek keh raha tha?
director.card: Tumhari baari: toh kya Sonu theek keh raha tha?

director.text: no

Haan, sahi hai. Toh poora jawab: tile ka kona right angle hai; Sonu ki baat theek nahi thi, kyunki Sonu ka tester seedha tha aur tile tirchi, isliye fit nahi hua tha; ghumane se tile ka kona nahi badla. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. Samose ki nok, pizza ke tukde ki nok, ya ek tirchi rakhi kitaab ka kona: inmein se right angle kaunsa hai?
director.card: Samose ki nok, pizza ke tukde ki nok, ya ek tirchi rakhi kitaab ka kona: inmein se right angle kaunsa hai?

Sahi jawab. Suno, samose aur pizza ki nok patli hain; tirchi kitaab ka kona ghumane se nahi badla, woh right angle hai. Ek square carrom board ko ghuma kar tircha rakha. Zoya ka kehna hai ki ab uske sirf do kone right angle hain. Kya Zoya ka kehna theek hai?

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki carrom board square hai, aur ghumane se uske chaaron kone right angle hi rehte hain, sirf do nahi. Ek square patang hawa mein tirchi ud rahi hai. Uske upar wale kone par tester patang ke saath ghuma kar rakho: kona kam khula niklega, bilkul fit hoga, ya zyada?
director.card: Ek square patang hawa mein tirchi ud rahi hai. Uske upar wale kone par tester patang ke saath ghuma kar rakho: kona kam khula niklega, bilkul fit hoga, ya zyada?

director.text: fit

Bilkul sahi. Patang square hai, toh tirchi udne par bhi uska har kona right angle hai; ghuma kar rakha tester bilkul fit hoga. Ab woh kone dekhenge jo tester mein fit nahi hote, jaise cake ki nok, aur unhe right angle se milayenge. Ab tak samajh aaya?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
batting

Doosri bhuja seedhe kinaaron ke beech ho toh right angle se kam, doosre kinaare par toh barabar, paar ho toh zyada. Yeh cake ke tukde ki nok hai. Is par tester rakhoge, toh nok right angle se kam khuli niklegi ya zyada?
